name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: A rural housing scheme providing financial assistance to houseless households and those living in kutcha/dilapidated houses to construct a pucca house, with beneficiaries selected from verified SECC 2011 and Awaas+ survey data.
benefits: Financial assistance paid in installments tied to construction progress (verified via geo-tagged photos), plus convergence support of around 90-95 days of MGNREGA wages for construction labour and assistance for toilet construction under Swachh Bharat Mission.
eligibility: Household is houseless or lives in a house with kutcha walls and kutcha roof (0, 1, or 2 rooms)
Household must appear in the SECC 2011 / Awaas+ survey data, verified by the gram sabha
Priority to SC/ST households, minorities, widows, persons with disabilities, freed bonded labourers, and families of martyred defence/paramilitary personnel
Owning a motorised two-wheeler is an automatic exclusion under PMAY-G rules

eligibility_rules.complex_reason: Requires appearance in SECC 2011 / Awaas+ survey data verified by the gram sabha - not determinable from self-reported fields alone.

documents_required: Household entry proof in SECC 2011 / Awaas+ list
how_to_apply: Verify inclusion in the Awaas+/SECC list at your gram panchayat; the panchayat secretary or block office initiates registration on pmayg.nic.in. If missed, request inclusion during an ongoing Awaas+ survey window through the gram sabha.
